hebrewText: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑/נוּ עֵינֶי/ךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל יִצְעָן֙ בַּל יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָי/ו֙ לָ/נֶ֔צַח וְ/כָל חֲבָלָ֖י/ו בַּל יִנָּתֵֽקוּ

tokens.bdb: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of
tokens.kjv: behold, look, prophesy, provide, see.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to gaze at; mentally to perceive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to gaze at; mentally to perceive
tokens.explanation: to gaze at; mentally to perceive
tokens.explanationEn: to gaze at; mentally to perceive

tokens.bdb: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
tokens.kjv: Zion.

tokens.bdb: building; a city
tokens.kjv: city.

tokens.bdb: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
tokens.kjv: appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).
tokens.explanation: moed — tempo fixo, estação, assembleia sagrada, festival

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
tokens.explanation: ayin — olho, olhos, aparência, fonte (de água), perspectiva

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender

tokens.bdb: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jerusalem.

tokens.bdb: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
tokens.kjv: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: at home; hence  lovely; also  a home
tokens.enLiteralWord: at home; hence  lovely; also  a home
tokens.explanation: at home; hence  lovely; also  a home
tokens.explanationEn: at home; hence  lovely; also  a home

tokens.bdb: secure; in a bad sense, haughty
tokens.kjv: that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare H7946 (שַׁלְאֲנָן).

tokens.bdb: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
tokens.kjv: covering, (dwelling) (place), home, tabernacle, tent.

tokens.bdb: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: to load up (beasts), i.e. to migrate
tokens.kjv: be taken down.

tokens.bdb: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
tokens.kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

tokens.bdb: a peg
tokens.kjv: nail, paddle, pin, stake.

tokens.bdb: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view)
tokens.kjv: alway(-s), constantly, end, ([phrase] n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin
tokens.kjv: band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, region, rope, snare, sorrow, tackling.

tokens.bdb: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
tokens.kjv: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

tokens.bdb: to tear off
tokens.kjv: break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.
